title: api-gateway: adaptive routing, streaming proxy buffer tuning, and OpenAI-compat payload limits
author: Aisha Kumar
description:
Motivation: Production incidents and internal perf tests surfaced two recurring issues: 1) long-tail latency spikes for streaming requests when large tool-calling payloads hit the gateway, and 2) unexpected truncation/400s from the OpenAI-compat layer when payloads approach previously undocumented limits. This PR introduces three coordinated changes: adaptive routing by payload size & observed model latency, streaming proxy buffer tuning with backpressure improvements, and explicit OpenAI-compat payload limit handling (400 -> 413 with clear error body) plus docs. The changes are gated behind a feature flag (api.gateway.adaptive_routing_v2) and a runtime knob for buffer sizes.

What I changed (summary):
- Adaptive routing: route requests to lower-latency pools when payload_size > configurable threshold or when tail latency SLOs are breached for a model route. The routing policy now considers (1) declared payload_size header, (2) recent p95/p99 per-model latency buckets, and (3) customer tier routing rules. This avoids routing large function-calling requests to best-effort pools.
- Streaming proxy: increased internal write buffer from 64KB -> 256KB by default, added an adaptive flush timer, and improved backpressure handling so slow downstream clients don't cause unbounded mem growth.
- OpenAI-compat: normalize chunked streaming headers, add explicit payload-size validation with a descriptive 413 JSON body for compatibility, and ensure chunk boundaries align with function-calling JSON framing.
- Docs & SDK: update OpenAI-compat docs with payload guidance and an example for retry/backoff patterns for streaming.
- Tests & metrics: add unit tests for buffer edge cases, integration test simulating large tool-calls, and new metrics: api.gateway.streaming.buffer_overflow_retries and api.gateway.routing.fallback_count.

Checklist: - [x] Add feature flag and config defaults - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Docs update - [x] Metrics and dashboards updated - [x] QA load test (internal perf lab)

Backward compatibility notes: Defaults are conservative; feature is off for existing customers until rollout. OpenAI-compat change returns 413 rather than generic 400 for oversized payloads to be explicit; SDKs updated to surface this error for retry guidance. No breaking schema changes.

review_comments: Tomás Rivera: The routing changes look good overall. Concern: do we risk oscillation if we route away and then back-fail? Suggest adding a short hysteresis window or sticky routing for N requests.
Aisha Kumar (author): Good point — added sticky routing for 30s per client session and a circuit-breaker on route switches; test added (routing/policy_test.go).
Morgan Lee: The buffer increase is fine, but have we quantified mem impact at 10k concurrent streams? Please include metrics from perf lab.

Aisha Kumar (author): Perf lab results attached in CI run: at 10k concurrent streams default 256KB increased mem by ~3%, tail latency p99 improved 18% for large payload workloads. Added comments to observability dashboard and docs.
Evan Chen: OpenAI-compat 413 change is a breaking behavior for some clients expecting 400. We should add clear release notes and SDK guidance.
Aisha Kumar (author): Added explicit release notes and updated Python/TS SDK snippets to handle 413 and suggested retry/backoff pattern. Also gated rollout with feature flag for safer rollout.
Tomás Rivera: CI flake in streaming_proxy_test on the first run — looks like a race in the test harness. Marked as requested changes.
Aisha Kumar (author): Fixed test harness race by using a mocked network writer with deterministic flush signals; re-ran CI.

release_notes: Improved streaming stability: increased default proxy buffer and adaptive flush to reduce tail latency for large streaming requests.
Adaptive routing: gateway now considers payload_size and recent latency when selecting pools; reduces long-tail latency for large tool-calls.
OpenAI-compat: explicit oversized payload response (413) with guidance; SDKs updated to recommend backoff/retry on 413.
Feature gated rollout: api.gateway.adaptive_routing_v2 (off by default).
